reason: This looks like a cross-cutting refactor of the `handle cols` abstraction, which is central to row-handle resolution in both planning and execution. Even though the subject sounds like code movement, it touches broad planner core paths (`logical_plan_builder`, `find_best_task`, `point_get_plan`, physical/logical plans) plus executor paths (`delete`, `index_merge_reader`, `union_scan`, `admin`, `analyze`). That combination raises real risk of planner/executor semantic regressions around handle inference, access path selection, point-get behavior, and row identity handling. The blast radius is large enough to justify a focused Blocker/High hunt.
